dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 準備が整い次第、はじめてもよろしいでしょうか？いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Shall we begin whenever you're ready? Is that okay with you?

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。それでは、始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll go ahead and get us started then.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 実は、人間関係で悩んでいます
dialogue.English: Actually, I'm struggling with a relationship issue.

dialogue.content: それはお困りですね
dialogue.English: That must be difficult.

dialogue.content: どんな場所でのお悩みですか？
dialogue.English: Where is this problem taking place?

dialogue.content: 人前だと話してもらえるのですが、1：1だと完全に無視されています。職場です。
dialogue.English: At my workplace. They'll talk to me in front of other people, but when it's just the two of us, I'm completely ignored.

dialogue.content: それはつらいですよね
dialogue.English: That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: はい。でも、周りに人がいると普通なので理解してもらえなくて。
dialogue.English: Yes. But because they act normally when others are around, no one understands.

dialogue.content: それは嫌な気分になってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: That must make you feel awful.

dialogue.content: そうなのです。仕事に行きたくなくて
dialogue.English: Exactly. It makes me not want to go to work.

dialogue.content: そんなつらい気持ちの中で、お勤めされているんですね、本当にお辛いですよね
dialogue.English: You're continuing to work despite these painful feelings; that must be truly difficult.

dialogue.content: それは、特定の方からそんな風にされているのですか？
dialogue.English: Is it one particular person who is treating you that way?

dialogue.content: 顔を、合わせない日もあるのですが、そんな日はほっとします。そうです。
dialogue.English: There are days when we don't cross paths, and those days are a relief. Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: その方は、人が見ている時だけは、取り繕っているのですね
dialogue.English: So that person only puts on a front when others are watching.

dialogue.content: そうなのです。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・顔を見るとしんどくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand... It must be exhausting just to see their face.

dialogue.content: ましてや
dialogue.English: All the more so...

dialogue.content: はい。職場は私のほうが長いので、相談しづらくて・・・
dialogue.English: Yes. I've been at this workplace longer, so it's hard for me to talk to anyone about it...

dialogue.content: なんだか、周りの人にはいい人に見せて、自分には、いじわるをするのか、って思ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: It makes you feel like, "Why are they acting so nice to everyone else but being so mean to me?" doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 行きたくもなくなりますよね
dialogue.English: Of course you wouldn't want to go to work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。何年くらいお勤めなんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How long have you been working there?

dialogue.content: どうしたものかと。上司に相談しようかとも思ったのですが、上司はその人と仲が良くて。転勤があるので私はここが３年目です。上司と、その人は４月に転勤してこられました。
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do. I thought about talking to my supervisor, but they're close with that person. Because there are transfers, this is my third year here. My supervisor and that person were transferred here in April.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。やりにくいですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. That makes things very difficult...

dialogue.content: はい。やりづらいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's very difficult.

dialogue.content: すこしでも、軽くなるように一緒に考えていきましょうね
dialogue.English: Let's think about this together so we can lighten your burden, even just a little.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ところで、相談者さんのお名前を聞かせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: By the way, may I ask your name?

dialogue.content: ニックネームでもかまいませんよ
dialogue.English: A nickname is fine as well.

dialogue.content: Ｊ　でお願いします。
dialogue.English: Please call me J.

dialogue.content: ］さんでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: J, is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ところで、
dialogue.English: Thank you. By the way,

dialogue.content: (J)です。
dialogue.English: It's J.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたしましたJさんですね？
dialogue.English: My apologies. J, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: Jさん。教えてくださって、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me, J.

dialogue.content: ところで、
dialogue.English: By the way,

dialogue.content: どんなことで、一対一の時に、嫌な思いをされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What specifically makes you feel uncomfortable when you're one-on-one?

dialogue.content: （ゆっくりでかまいませんよ）
dialogue.English: (Please take your time.)

dialogue.content: 休憩が一緒になると、目を合わさず、スマホばかり見ていて、話しかけても無視です。ほかの人が入ってくると、笑顔で声かけをしています。
dialogue.English: When our breaks overlap, they won't make eye contact with me, just stare at their phone and ignore me if I try to speak to them. But when someone else comes in, they greet them with a smile.

dialogue.content: えぇーーーーーーー！！無視ですか？！
dialogue.English: What?! They ignore you?!

dialogue.content: しかも、目も合わせないなんて…本当に、感じ悪いですよね
dialogue.English: And on top of that, to not even make eye contact... That's really rude, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。ちょっと失礼ですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's quite rude, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 本当に、失礼ですよね
dialogue.English: It's extremely rude.

dialogue.content: 良くこらえておられますよね
dialogue.English: You've been putting up with a lot.

dialogue.content: 仕事中はどうなのでしょう/?
dialogue.English: What is it like during work hours?

dialogue.content: 休憩が一緒になることが少ないので、こんなものか…と黙っています。ほかの人がいれば仕事中は何事もない感じです。が、これどうしましょう？と声をかけると一度目は虫です。２・３度声をかけると仕方なく返事が返ってきます。
dialogue.English: We don't have breaks together often, so I stay quiet, thinking this is just how it is. If other people are around during work, it's like nothing is wrong. But, if I ask them, 'What should I do about this?' they ignore me the first time. After I ask two or three times, they finally reply, reluctantly.

dialogue.content: 無視です
dialogue.English: They ignore me.

dialogue.content: 無視だなんて、気分も悪いし、用も足りませんよね
dialogue.English: Being ignored feels awful, and it makes it hard to get things done, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: しかも
dialogue.English: On top of that,

dialogue.content: 人前でそんな態度だなんて…
dialogue.English: ...to have an attitude like that in a work setting...

dialogue.content: なお、話しかけづらくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It must make it even harder to talk to them.

dialogue.content: なるべくかかわらないようにはしています。もしかして私の思い過ごしかなと思い、１：１の時に何度か話しかけてみたのですが、無視されます。
dialogue.English: I try to avoid interacting with them as much as possible. I wondered if I might be overthinking it, so I tried talking to them several times when we were one-on-one, but I get ignored.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、しんどくても、話しかけてみたのに、無視だなんて、困りますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Even though it was difficult for you, you tried to talk to them, only to be ignored. That's very troubling, isn't it?

dialogue.content: それか、尋ねたことに対して、なんでも、「はい」だけが返ってきます。
dialogue.English: Or, no matter what I ask, all I get back is a single "yes."

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・悲しくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see... That must make you feel very sad.

dialogue.content: 私を嫌いですか？って質問してみようかと思うくらい　はいだけが返ってきます。
dialogue.English: It's to the point where I feel like asking, "Do you dislike me?" All I ever get back is "yes."

dialogue.content: そうですよね。Jさんの本当につらいお気持ち、お察しします。
dialogue.English: I understand. J, I can imagine how truly painful this is for you.

dialogue.content: 一時は本当に嫌だったのですが、そう思うと仕事でミスをしてしまい、今はかかわらないようにしようと考えないようにしようと思っています。
dialogue.English: At one point, it really bothered me, but when I think about it, I end up making mistakes at work. So now I'm trying to avoid them and not to think about it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.content: ミスしてしまうのも無理もないことだと思います。
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable that you would make mistakes under the circumstances.

dialogue.content: Jさんの本当にお辛い気持ち、お察しします
dialogue.English: J, I truly empathize with how painful this must be for you.

dialogue.content: 年齢が近いので、４月からなんとなく
dialogue.English: Because we're close in age, since April, I've just had this feeling...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 違和感があったのですが、先日私の　悪口？をその人が言っているというのが耳に入り、余計に意識したせいか、無視されるようになりました。
dialogue.English: ...I've felt that something was off. But the other day, I heard that this person was bad-mouthing me. Maybe because I became more conscious of it after that, they started ignoring me.

dialogue.content: つらいですよね
dialogue.English: That's so painful.

dialogue.content: 余計に意識してしまうには、どんなことが耳に入ってしまったのですか？
dialogue.English: What was it that you overheard that made you more conscious of it?

dialogue.content: （話やすいところからで構いませんよ）
dialogue.English: (You can start wherever is easiest for you.)

dialogue.content: 余計な仕事をする。ということでした。
dialogue.English: It was that I "do unnecessary work."

dialogue.content: どんなことを、余計だと？
dialogue.English: What did they consider unnecessary?

dialogue.content: その人のチームの仕事で、その中の一人が困っていたことを手伝ったりしたことで。
dialogue.English: It was because I helped someone on their team who was having trouble with their work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: Jさんとは違う部署の、その方の部署の人のことを助けたくててつだったのですよね
dialogue.English: So you helped someone in that person's department, which is different from yours, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 部署を超えても、お立場的にも、助けてあげたかったんですよね？
dialogue.English: Even though it was a different department, given your position, you wanted to help them, right?

dialogue.content: その人からすれば、余計なことだったのだと思います。
dialogue.English: From that person's perspective, I suppose it was unnecessary meddling.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。このことは、
dialogue.English: I see. This situation...

dialogue.content: かかわらないことが、一番かな？と思っています。
dialogue.English: I'm thinking that not getting involved is the best thing to do, maybe?

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまいますよねその方の部署のどなたか、上司には相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way. Have you spoken to anyone in their department, or to a supervisor?

dialogue.content: 上司は、その人と同時に転勤してきたので、同志という感じで仲良くて、話せません。
dialogue.English: My supervisor was transferred at the same time as that person, so they're close, like comrades, and I can't talk to them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね少しお話を整理させてくださいね
dialogue.English: I see. Let me summarize to make sure I understand.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: あなたは、3年お勤めでいらっしゃる。問題の方は、最近異動でやって来た別の部署の方。その部署の方の上司さんも、一緒にその部署に来られて、仲良くしていて、報告することもままならない。ということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Okay, so you've been working there for three years. The person you're having trouble with recently transferred in and is in another department. Their supervisor transferred in with them, they're close, and that makes it difficult for you to report the issue. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: そんな感じです。上司は、総括ですが。
dialogue.English: That's about right. The supervisor is in charge of everything, though.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、総括なのに、伝えられないのは、困りますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Even though they're in charge of everything, not being able to talk to them is a difficult situation.

dialogue.content: でも、Jさんは、
dialogue.English: But, J,

dialogue.content: 関わらないのが一番かなって思われるんですね？
dialogue.English: you feel that avoiding them is the best option, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい。ミスしたくないので。
dialogue.English: Yes, because I don't want to make any mistakes.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: ただ、もやっとするので相談しました。
dialogue.English: It's just that I have this lingering, unresolved feeling, so I wanted to talk about it.

dialogue.content: 周りの方を助けてあげたいと、実行されるJさんですもの。お気持ち軽くしていきましょうね
dialogue.English: You're the kind of person who sees someone who needs help and takes action. Let's work together to ease that feeling for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 加えて、しっかり仕事をしたいからこそ、コミュニケーションを取ろうと努力されているJさんは、
dialogue.English: In addition, J, you're making an effort to communicate precisely because you want to do your job well.

dialogue.content: 本当に、忍耐強く、思いやりのある方だと思います。だからこそ、やり取りがうまくいかず、ミスをなくしたい。って思いますよねいかがですか？
dialogue.English: I think you are a truly patient and compassionate person. That's why it's so frustrating when the interaction doesn't go well, and you just want to eliminate mistakes. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: すみません。お時間となってしまいました、
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, it looks like our time is up.

dialogue.content: 本当に悩んでいることでした。気持ちの整理ができました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: This was something I was really struggling with. I feel I've been able to sort out my feelings. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: すみません次回の機会に、また、おねがいいたします。
dialogue.English: I apologize. Please, let's continue this next time.

dialogue.content: 時間となりましたので、終了とさせていた出しますね
dialogue.English: Our time is up, so we'll have to end our session here.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I look forward to our next session.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Goodbye.
